logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.

CLIP: episode 28, 1 segment(s), 27s
[00:20.40-00:22.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening): "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
[00:22.80-00:26.70] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.
[00:24.80-00:26.50] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining): "Rupert..."
[00:26.70-00:28.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.
[00:26.70-00:28.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Commanding): "Stop this!"
[00:28.40-00:32.80] CAMERA: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.
[00:28.80-00:30.30] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm): "She is innocent."
[00:30.80-00:32.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant): "She saved me!"
[00:32.80-00:34.90] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
[00:33.20-00:34.60] JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved): "Your Grace..."
[00:34.90-00:37.70] CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
[00:35.00-00:37.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting): "I know what happened to me!"
[00:37.70-00:43.00] CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.
[00:38.20-00:40.00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning): "I was poisoned!"
[00:40.30-00:42.20] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing): "And you... you knew!"
[00:43.00-00:47.25] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.
[00:43.60-00:45.30] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening): "Catherine knew!"
[00:45.60-00:47.00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping): "They have been—"
[00:46.80-00:47.25] ACTION: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

[00:48.20-00:49.70] JULIANA (Panicked, Screaming): "Let me help her!"
[00:49.50-00:52.10] JULIANA (Desperate): "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
[00:52.20-00:56.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.
[00:52.80-00:53.60] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern): "You see?"
[00:54.00-00:56.60] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister): "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
[00:56.80-01:01.30] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.
[00:57.00-00:58.70] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining): "I am not delusional!"
[00:58.60-01:00.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering): "Of course you are not."
[01:00.10-01:01.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive): "You are merely confused."
[01:01.30-01:06.80] CAMERA: Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.
[01:01.60-01:04.80] CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking): "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."
[01:04.90-01:06.80] CATHERINE (Smug): "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
[01:06.80-01:10.50] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.
[01:07.20-01:10.20] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute): "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
[01:10.50-01:12.00] CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
[01:10.80-01:12.00] ACTION: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.
[01:11.20-01:12.00] JULIANA (Crying Out): "No!"
[01:12.00-01:15.30] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.
[01:12.20-01:15.10] CATHERINE (Insolent, Sneering): "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"
[01:15.30-01:15.35] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.
